conclusions.recovery: Both final1 verifier reports pass while explicitly identifying the same original PS5.1 Desktop STA application run. Each has 16 completed/released bounded natives, 41 unchanged bindings and three independently decoded outputs; corresponding output hashes match across verifier runs.
conclusions.corrected_guide: Selection accepts the actual valid JPG/PNG and compares its probed dimensions and preservation. Actual guide-function proof passes in both verifier shells, rejects selected artwork when Cancel was requested, and records 13 completed/released natives each. Captures are retained before verification.
conclusions.cancellation: Original T16 final22 reports and binder hashes match: nine passing automated cases per shell, 18 total; source/synthetic preservation, disposal and exact cleanup pass. Controlled console key records and owned-host interruption are not physical observations.
conclusions.acceptance: A49 passes under the explicitly recorded user-requested mixed method: named actual BAT message and PS5.1 selection plus both-shell real Windows software checks. A50 retains its separately established long-file/default-Music pass. TASKS, ACCEPTANCE, STATUS and handoff agree.
conclusions.human_observation: Janne Vuorela confirmed the actual folder-on-BAT interaction and visible Completed with failures message. Neither the empty original BAT observation nor missing final DONE was rewritten.
conclusions.source_safety: Production entry/helper/BAT and the existing cancellation harness remain unchanged against HEAD. Only task-local tools, documents and evidence change.
conclusions.privacy: New recovery reports allowlist technical fields and hashes; selected podcast path/name/tags/media and raw diagnostic captures are not present in the reviewed public additions. No personal directory or ordinary Music scan was performed by this review.
conclusions.handoff: No further Windows guide action is required under the revised method. Main integration is owner-gated; T21 follows integration. No release, phone or listening completion is claimed.
